subject: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: Token volume & peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: Token volume & peak TPS

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for taking the call today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so our pricing team can put together an accurate Hosted API estimate. Can you confirm the following by end of week?

1) Expected monthly token volume (tokens/month) for the first 6 months and your long-term target (12+ months).
2) Peak TPS (tokens per second) during burst windows and the expected sustained TPS.
3) Any SLA or throughput constraints that would require reserved capacity vs. standard hosted routing.
4) Target budget per 1M tokens (if you have an internal target $/1M tokens we should match).

To make the math easier, a few examples you can copy/paste:
- Low: 10M tokens/month, peak 5 TPS, target $/1M = $200
- Mid: 100M tokens/month, peak 25 TPS, target $/1M = $75
- High: 1B tokens/month, peak 200 TPS, target $/1M = $25

If you prefer, send over an export of expected monthly user counts and average prompt/response lengths and we can convert that to tokens (small CSV is fine). Attaching a simple template.

Next steps: once we have those numbers I’ll run a quick cost simulation and propose a hosted plan (and show dedicated capacity breakeven if it makes sense).

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: Acme-Usage-Template.csv (template to capture users, avg tokens/session)

From: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@acme-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T18:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: Token volume & peak TPS

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear follow-up. Below are our rough estimates based on the product roadmap and current pilot:

- Month 1 (pilot): ~12M tokens/month
- Month 2-6 (ramp): 40M -> 120M tokens/month (we expect to hit ~120M by month 6)
- Long-term (12+ months): planning target ~400M tokens/month if retention/usage hits targets

Traffic profile:
- Typical sustained TPS (global average): ~3-6 TPS
- Peak bursts (marketing events / sync jobs): short spikes up to 50 TPS for 10-15 minutes; sustained peak windows around 20-30 TPS for 1-2 hours once/month

Budget/Unit economics:
- Target internal budget: $50-$90 per 1M tokens (we’re cost-sensitive; anything >$100/1M is a stretch unless SLA/latency guarantees are included)

We’ll attach the usage export (sample) for June to give you tokenization context. Let me know if you want more granular session-level data.

Appreciate the follow-up — Bob and I are on PTO next week but can catch up the week of March 30.

Best,
Alice Moreno
Head of Product, Acme Analytics
alice.moreno@acme-analytics.com

Attachment: Acme-Usage-Export.csv

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Bob Lee <bob.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: Token volume & peak TPS

Alice —

Perfect, this is exactly what we needed. Quick notes from our side based on your numbers:

- Cost simulation (rough): if we price at $75/1M tokens, your ramp to 120M/mo ~ $9k/mo; long-term 400M/mo ~ $30k/mo. These are hosted API list-level estimates (no volume discounts or committed reserved pricing).
- Peak handling: short spikes to 50 TPS are within our hosted burst capacity, but if you see sustained 20-30 TPS windows every month we should model a Dedicated reservation scenario to guarantee latency. I’ll include a breakeven calc in the sheet.
- SLA/latency: standard hosted SLOs should cover your needs for now. If you need guaranteed p99 latency we can include that in a dedicated plan.

I’ve attached a quick pricing worksheet (Redwood-Hosted-Pricing-Sheet.xlsx) that shows line-item math (tokens -> $) for your pilot and projected ramp, plus a rough dedicated breakeven point. Can you confirm availability for a 30-min call the week of March 30 to walk through the numbers and go over any compliance questions?

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue, Mar 30 — 10:00-10:30am
- Wed, Mar 31 — 2:00-2:30pm
- Thu, Apr 1 — 9:00-9:30am

If none of those work, send 2x windows that do. I’ll also loop in our solutions engineer if you want a quick demo of batching/kv-cache behavior that affects unit economics.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
